items.title: Why don’t machine learning research agents overfit?
items.summary: Machine learning, at its core, is about generalization, not memorization. You hand your learning algorithm a pile of training examples and use them to fit a model. But the goal is not to perform well on the training examples — that's easy, you could just memorize the answers. The goal is to perform well on new examples that you have never before seen.
